They are kept separate from the northwestern ṣuvaṭ branch; added classifier material is excluded.

This n-bearing regional dry adjective explains the entire hukna/hukana stem; the initial h corresponds to the eastern x/s series and the ending vowel is retained. The link identifies that expanded dry family and leaves regional contact transmission open; hukase and other additional verbal suffixes are not silently stripped.
